title: Invitation links name the way in: signin=org or signin=password
spec: The invitation link takes an optional signin parameter, once, with the value org or password (SignInWay::Organization / Password); any other value or a repeat is LinkError::Parameter; links without it parse as before and are written without it; InvitationLink::with_signin and signin. The server's invitations (invite, offline or through a running server) carry signin=org when the data directory has an identity.toml that parses, and nothing otherwise; an identity.toml that does not parse makes invite fail. The enrollment screen reads the pasted link: signin=org hides the password field and 'Enroll this device' and says the organization signs the person in; signin=password hides 'Enroll with your organization'; no signin offers both.
